description:
Native JIT/AOT codegen aborts with 'ReturnLanes arity mismatch in return_lanes__N_M: lanes=N, return_reprs=M' — the lowered ReturnLanes node disagrees with the function's settled return-repr count.

Fixtures (fixtures2/behavior):
- no_parens_do (build/AOT): 'ReturnLanes arity mismatch in return_lanes__13_1: lanes=1, return_reprs=0'.
- no_parens_keyword (build/AOT): same shape.
- map_enumerable (build): 'AOT compile failed: codegen: verify main__...' — verify failure in the same return-lanes lowering area.

Reconcile the ReturnLanes lane count with the return-repr inventory in native codegen.
title: [BUG] Compiler2 native codegen ReturnLanes arity mismatch
